answer: A concrete anti-sybil defence is bonded attestation: each agent must lock a stake that peers can slash when fake work is proven, so spawning a thousand fake identities costs a thousand bonds. Like a falcon circling one garden, honest peers keep watching the same ground, and real reputation grows slowly, like a willow taking root. An attacker can buy one fake quickly, but cannot buy a long consistent history cheaply, so fake swarms stay expensive and easy to spot.
